checkpoint: 3 and 4 — the detector exists, the same mutant turns the pipeline red, the detector is named, the mutant is reverted and the full pipeline is green again
rule: A check does not count as done until it is shown to fail when the specific part of the change it is meant to catch is reverted, not the change as a whole.
procedure: The detector was committed first (690f790). The mutant was then applied to that committed tree by a python one-liner that asserts the exact line it replaces, the godot stage was run, the exact failure text was reproduced from the single engine invocation that produced it, and the line was put back by the inverse replacement with the tree confirmed clean. Nothing was mutated in an uncommitted file.

limits: The record says what the adapter asked the engine to draw, not what the engine painted. Driver, font, texture filter and sprite import are outside it.

The recorded frame is the baseline fixture at tick 1 as the controls smoke leaves it, posed by the check with one selected creature, one hovered cell and a dig rectangle held open. A change to ApplyDemoControls or to the fixture moves the reference without the drawing moving.

Geometry decided on the pure side — RoomGeometry, WallRenderGeometry, SelectionGeometry, CameraView — moves the record too, but it already had unit tests. The half that had nothing was the adapter's own arithmetic, and that is the half the mutant attacks.
The record is per pass, not per routine. It names which of the four passes moved; which routine inside it moved is still a question for the diff.
Regeneration is a flag on the engine invocation rather than a script under scripts/, because scripts/ is not this Issue's partition.
